notes.title: Update 1.2.1.0
notes.content:
Howdy, folks!  Just making a minor update.

- Corrected the text in the 'Help' menu to show the correct key command for full-screening the game on PC.

- Selitrius's scene would display an empty frame with no picture sometimes (while displaying it correctly in the extras scene). This has been corrected.

- Corrected an issue where a couple of system languages were still causing issues with the game not starting correctly.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
Howdy, folks!  With this update, we wanted to fix a couple of issues users were having. Along with that, we've added a couple of extra scenes for folks to find and enjoy.

- Bug fix: Playing with a culture that uses LTR text or a different variation on floating numbers no longer crashes.
- Bug fix: Playing on an Apple Silicone system no longer has strange graphical glitches.
- Bug fix: Using Garret's door can cause a crash if Garret is not present.
- Bug fix: Updated Kal's "Do not enter" speaker pathing.

- Enhancement: Added extra text to the help screen for item cycling.
- Enhancement: Added Calen Reading to Warrick scene
- Enhancement: Added Selitrius Back Rub scene
